items.headline: Manchester United lose 2-0 to Hull City in Premier League opener
items.summary: Man United suffered defeat on opening day to newly-promoted Hull City at the MKM Stadium, conceding twice in the first half.

items.headline: Michael Carrick delivers team news for Hull City fixture
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick released his first team news bulletin of the 2026-27 season ahead of the Hull opener.

items.headline: United made summer signings of Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans
items.summary: Manchester United invested £55m net in midfield, signing Santos from Chelsea and Tielemans from Aston Villa, while selling Rasmus Hojlund.
